proposed_fixes.title: Remember the selected Dock network
plan: Inspect the Dock Receive/Send adapter selection and persisted settings.
If confirmed, persist the selected adapter identity and restore it when available.
Fall back safely when the adapter is removed or unavailable.

confidence.rationale: The symptom makes this a plausible investigation, but the causal mechanism has not been isolated.

verification: A selected adapter remains selected after restart; unavailable adapters fall back without blocking the Dock.
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The extension may choose a default interface at startup instead of restoring the user-selected adapter; the issue does not establish intended selection semantics.

comment.body: Thanks for describing the wrong Receive/Send network after startup. Could you clarify whether you want the Dock to remember a manually selected adapter across restarts or automatically choose the currently active network? Please include the displayed names of the desired and selected adapters. This determines the correct selection behavior.
